name: comp-309

frames.best_why: Frame 6 shows both text lines and all controls with the cursor well away from them.
frames.render_note: The left edge is cropped, so the circular rocket badge is cut off.

tagline: Two-line launch strip pairs a headline with a Try now pill.
summary: A full-width dark banner with a bold headline over a muted one-line description, a white Try now button and a close X that removes it.
appearance: A full-width dark strip holds a bold white headline above a smaller grey line on the left. At the right sit a white rounded Try now button and a faint X; a circular rocket badge is cut off at the left edge.
behaviour: Pressing the X hides the strip, and the X brightens on hover. Try now has no action wired, so the clip only shows the resting banner.
demo_content: Boost your experience with coss.com; The new feature is live! Try it out and let us know what you think.
search_phrases: feature launch bar with try now
bar with headline and short description
full width promo bar with close
use_when: You want a short launch message with a headline, supporting line and one action button.
avoid_when: Two lines of fixed copy with no persistence, so the strip returns on every reload.
customise: Headline, description and button label are fixed in the file; visibility is a local flag with no props.
weight_why: Two short lines, one button and a single state flag.

a11y.note: Close is labelled and the rocket badge is hidden from screen readers, but the file adds no focus styling or reduced-motion handling.

issues: The crop hides the circular rocket badge at the left edge.
Try now has no handler, so the call to action is inert.
polish_why: Clear type hierarchy and tidy spacing; the hidden badge and inert button keep it ordinary.
